items.title: Dermalogica Conditioning Body Wash: Soap-Free Body Wash with Tea Tree and Eucalyptus #shorts
items.lead: Dermalogica Conditioning Body Wash: a soap-free, gently cleansing body wash that helps maintain the skin's lipid barrier.
items.hook: a soap-free, gently cleansing body wash that helps maintain the skin's lipid barrier.
facts: Soap-free, gently cleansing body wash; helps maintain the skin's lipid barrier (295 ml)
French rosemary, Chinese eucalyptus, tea tree and lemon oils, with sandalwood, lavender and clary sage
Work into a lather, then rinse; follow with a body moisturizer after the shower

scenes.caption: Conditioning Body Wash
scenes.say: Want a body wash that doesn't strip your skin? This is the Dermalogica Conditioning Body Wash.

scenes.caption: Soap-free
scenes.say: It's a soap-free, gently cleansing body wash, made to cleanse while helping maintain the skin's lipid barrier.

scenes.caption: Essential oils
scenes.say: It has French rosemary, Chinese eucalyptus, tea tree and lemon oils, with sandalwood, lavender and clary sage.

scenes.caption: How to use
scenes.say: Work it into a lather, then rinse. After the shower, follow with a body moisturizer.

scenes.caption: 295 ml
scenes.say: It comes in a two hundred and ninety-five milliliter bottle. The link is in the description.

items.title: How to Use Dermalogica Body Hydrating Cream (Lactic Acid) for Dry Skin #shorts
items.lead: Dermalogica Body Hydrating Cream: a silky, medium-weight body cream with naturally derived lactic acid that smooths skin and relieves dryness.
items.hook: a silky, medium-weight body cream with naturally derived lactic acid that smooths skin and relieves dryness.
facts: Silky, medium-weight cream that absorbs easily (295 ml pump bottle)
Naturally derived lactic acid and hydroxy acid extracts from cane sugar and apple smooth skin and relieve dryness
Orange oil and Chinese green tea soothe and soften; French lavender and Indonesian patchouli oils calm the senses
Smooth onto the body morning and night, after showering or bathing

scenes.caption: Body Hydrating Cream
scenes.say: Dry skin on your body? This is the Dermalogica Body Hydrating Cream, a silky, medium-weight cream that absorbs easily.

scenes.caption: Lactic acid
scenes.say: Naturally derived lactic acid and hydroxy acid extracts from cane sugar and apple smooth the skin and relieve dryness.

scenes.caption: Orange oil + green tea
scenes.say: Orange oil and Chinese green tea soothe and soften, while French lavender and Indonesian patchouli oils calm the senses.

scenes.caption: How to use
scenes.say: Smooth it onto your body morning and night, right after showering or bathing.

scenes.caption: 295 ml pump
scenes.say: It comes in a two hundred and ninety-five milliliter pump bottle. The link is in the description.
